questions.question: Ruffini endings in joint capsules respond to:

questions.question: Boutonniere deformity results from rupture of the:

questions.question: In iontophoresis, which ion is used for dermal ulcers?

questions.question: For an adult wheelchair, the overall width from rim to rim should be about:

questions.question: A physical therapist instructs a 67 year old female, four weeks status post total hip replacement in a home exercise Exercise Therapy 9 program. Which exercise description would be inappropriate for the patient?

options.A: Lie on your involved side and lift the involved leg towards the ceiling.
options.B: Place a rolled up towel under your knee. Rest the weight of the thigh on the towel roll. Lift the heel off the table so that you straighten the knee.
options.C: Lie on your back with the opposite knee bent. Tighten the thigh muscle, keeping the leg straight and lift the leg toward the ceiling
options.D: Lie on your back with knees bent. Raise you buttocks off the table

questions.explanation: Side-lying with the operated leg uppermost lifting it (abduction) is not appropriate early because of the positioning and abduction load; other exercises are safe.

questions.question: In congenital talipes equinovarus (clubfoot) the foot is:

questions.question: With ageing, DNA synthesis and cell division:
questions.explanation: Cells reach a finite division limit (Hayflick limit), and replication slows with age.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: The wavelength range used in clinical infrared lamps is:

questions.question: In multiple myeloma which of the following is seen:

questions.question: A toilet seat height of ______ is considered optimal for a wheelchair user.
questions.explanation: A raised seat of 17-19 inches matches the wheelchair seat for transfers.

questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: A-delta fibres carry:
questions.explanation: A-delta fibres conduct fast (sharp) pain and cold.

questions.subject: Physiology

questions.question: Which of the following statements is FALSE with respect to muscular changes seen in ageing?

questions.question: The primary benefits of CPM after ligament reconstruction is:

questions.question: If the greater tuberosity of the humerus is lost, which of the following movements will be affected?
questions.explanation: The greater tuberosity carries supraspinatus, infraspinatus and teres minor, so abduction and lateral rotation are affected.

questions.question: The ratio of paraffin wax to mineral oil used in a paraffin wax bath is:

questions.question: The intrinsic-plus (safe) position given to patients with a burn injury of the hand is:

options.A: 30 degrees wrist flexion with MCP extension
options.B: 15 degrees wrist extension, 70 degrees MCP flexion, PIP and DIP flexion
options.C: 15 degrees wrist extension, 70 degrees MCP flexion, PIP and DIP extension and thumb abduction
options.D: 15 degrees wrist flexion, 70 degrees MCP flexion, PIP and DIP extension

questions.question: Clutton's joints refers to which of the following

questions.question: Normal CSF pressure in an adult (lateral decubitus) is about:

questions.question: Pronase is distinct from enzymes like trypsin or chymotrypsin in protein chemistry because it:

options.A: Is a single enzyme with very narrow specificity for one bond
options.B: Is a mixture of non-specific proteolytic enzymes that causes complete hydrolysis of a protein down to free amino acids
options.C: Only cleaves carbohydrate-protein bonds in glycoproteins
options.D: Cannot hydrolyse peptide bonds at all

questions.explanation: Pronase is a mixture of non-specific proteolytic enzymes that, unlike the more selective trypsin/chymotrypsin/pepsin/elastase, causes complete hydrolysis of a protein all the way down to its free amino acids — useful for determining total amino acid composition rather than sequence.
questions.sourceBook: Satyanarayana, Biochemistry
questions.sourceChapter: Proteins and Amino Acids — Determination of Primary Structure
questions.subject: Biochemistry
